title: Salesloft Cadence
description: A Cadence in Salesloft is a structured sequence of touchpoints (calls, emails, tasks) designed to engage prospects.

cadence_function.description: Functional purpose of the cadence (e.g. outbound, inbound, event)

is_team.description: Whether this is a team cadence (shared) vs personal

shared.description: Whether the cadence is shared across the team

owner_id.description: ID of the user who owns this cadence

team_cadence.description: Whether this cadence is a team-level cadence

remove_bounced.description: Whether to remove people with bounced emails

opt_out_link_included.description: Whether opt-out links are included in emails

draft.description: Whether this cadence is still in draft state

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cadence was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cadence was last updated
